'''MLBB Mid Season Cup''', also known as '''MSC''' is a brand-new MLBB international championship, replacing the old [[MSC|MLBB Southeast Asia Cup]]. It now stands as the second international in-season major. It was announced as part of the '''Esports World Cup''' line-up on January 23, 2024 and marks the game's first official international major hosted outside Southeast Asia.{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/ESWCgg/status/1749763988475269462|title=Let's get ready for a HOT summer!|date=2024-01-23|author=Esports World Cup|language={{FlagNoLink|usuk}} English}} :''See [https://liquipedia.net/esports/Esports_World_Cup/2024 here] to read about the Esports World Cup 2024, the Calendar, the Club Standings and more.''

==Format==
* '''Wildcard:''' ''June 28th - 30th, 2024'' ** Group Stage *** Eight teams will be randomly drawn into two groups *** Single Round Robin, all matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}} *** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 1 team from each group}} advance to Decider Stage ** Decider Stage *** Match will be play in {{Abbr/Bo5}} *** {{Bgcolortext|up|The Winner}} qualify to Group Stage
* '''Group Stage:''' ''July 3rd - 7th, 2024'' ** Sixteen teams will be randomly drawn into four groups ** Single Round Robin, all matches are {{Abbr/Bo2}} ** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 2 teams}} from each group advance to Knockout Stage ** {{Bgcolortext|down|Bottom 2 teams}} from each group are eliminated
* '''Playoffs:''' ''July 10th - 14th, 2024'' ** Eight team will play in a single elimination bracket *** All Matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} until the Grand Final *** Grand Final is {{Abbr/Bo7}}

===Playoffs=== {{ShowBracket|id=MWI2025PLO}} ==Format==
* '''Group Stage:''' ''July 15th - 17th, 2025'' ** 16 teams drawn into 4 Groups *** Group draw order A → B → C → D will be repeated four times, Pool 1 will be drawn first. **** '''Pool 1''': The Philippines and Indonesia's 1st and 2nd **** '''Pool 2''': All remaining teams ** GSL Format *** All matches are played in {{abbr/Bo3}} ** Top 2 teams from each group qualified to '''Playoffs'''
* '''Playoffs:''' ''July 17th - 19th, 2025'' ** Top 1 team of each group will be paired with a Top 2 team ** Single Elimination ** Quarterfinals are played in {{abbr/Bo3}} ** Semifinals and Third-place match are played in {{abbr/Bo5}} ** Grandfinal is played in {{abbr/Bo7}}.
